purpose: Ground a compact nonordinal framework in existing R01–R07 evidence while preserving practitioner-dependent gaps.

records.title: Define the work and intended outcome
records.purpose: What specific work, consequence and affected outcome make attention worthwhile, within whose remit and as of when?
records.existing_evidence_support: Source-specific operating and consequence evidence supports distinguishing payment, reporting, records/control and useful resolution; scope, external dependencies and direct knowledge can change the need.
records.inference_limit: No common severity score, employer error rate, unmet-market share, individual worker impact or final organisational priority is established for this commission.
records.practitioner_dependent_gap: Permissioned case-specific need, consequence, current adequate performance and whose outcome matters; preserve measured versus reported/impression bases.

records.title: Compare feasible ways of meeting it
records.purpose: Which feasible routes were available at that date, including retaining or improving what already works?
records.existing_evidence_support: Delivery components, actual account/service/task, retained responsibility and continuing capability provide concrete comparison dimensions; options can combine and adequate retention is legitimate.
records.inference_limit: No product, supplier, technology, outsourcing or hiring route is shown to be best; declared availability is not a tested entitlement, local configuration or delivered benefit.
records.practitioner_dependent_gap: Actual alternatives considered and rejected/selected, their feasibility at the event and whether upstream conditions persisted under each route.

records.title: Establish who can authorise what
records.purpose: For the specific action and date, whose authority, advice, agreement or condition mattered?
records.existing_evidence_support: The inspected public rules/cases distinguish recommendation, delegated authority, funding, contracting, operational acceptance, external agreement and final release.
records.inference_limit: Public governance roles, notices and service declarations cannot establish a universal private-employer approval chain. Title and practical influence do not prove authority; silence is not pending approval.
records.practitioner_dependent_gap: Actual effective remit and knowledge for a recent event, including who could clear or escalate a material condition and what the contributor did not know.

records.title: Match value, resources and delivery evidence
records.purpose: What support is appropriate for this decision, and can the scoped option be afforded and delivered while payroll continues?
records.existing_evidence_support: The evidence supports keeping whole-life resources, future incremental cash and funding/timing separate, with benefit type, owner, baseline, uncertainty, usable skills and continuity conditions.
records.inference_limit: No supplied ROI, payback, salary-based saving, discount rate, staffing ratio, private hurdle rate or cash budget is established. Requested evidence, supplied evidence and believed influence are not a proven causal approval mechanism.
records.practitioner_dependent_gap: Actual evidence requested/supplied/accepted and the contributor's attributed account of its influence; costs/resources/funding and delivery conditions known in that case.

records.title: Record the last evidenced position
records.purpose: What was decided, committed, delivered and assessed, for which object and at which dates?
records.existing_evidence_support: Selected dated cases support separating option/object, decision disposition, contractual or other commitment, operational work and observed benefit; a stopped component and postponed rollout can coexist with continuation elsewhere.
records.inference_limit: No representative outcome rates, optimality, current status from a passed target or source silence, or causal remedy effect is established. Operation is not universal accuracy or realised financial value.
records.practitioner_dependent_gap: Original and revised dates, last evidenced event, actual later outcome where known, missingness and permissioned contributor knowledge.

records.title: Identify the next supported action or review
records.purpose: What is the material unresolved question or condition, who can act, and what evidence or review would be useful next?
records.existing_evidence_support: Dated dependencies, observation limits, affected-party control, suitable evaluation and explicit alternative explanations support a proportionate next-evidence/action record.
records.inference_limit: This is an analyst application, not a validated action recommendation or promise to secure approval. Waiting, retaining an adequate arrangement, revising or stopping may be legitimate; no universal review cadence is prescribed.
records.practitioner_dependent_gap: Actual next decision/owner/time window if known, what would change the priority and later evidence about whether an action was adopted or helped.

hypotheses.proposition: A compact set of linked views helps readers turn a need into a more useful next-decision explanation.
hypotheses.needed_evidence: Permissioned practitioner use/comprehension and case review; record contrary/unused views without inventing a usability test.

hypotheses.proposition: Specific evidence or a clarified condition affected a particular investment decision.
hypotheses.needed_evidence: Separate requested, supplied and accepted evidence from the contributor's belief about influence; seek supported actual events without claiming causal proof from recollection.

hypotheses.proposition: A suggested action can remove or reduce a material barrier.
hypotheses.needed_evidence: Actual adopted response and later effect in its context. An externally suggested response or plausible mechanism is not proof.

hypotheses.proposition: The case-to-decision contribution is useful and differentiated enough for a paid JGA research product.
hypotheses.needed_evidence: Specific buyer use, alternatives/free substitutes, approval/funding and credible next step in The Table work; public evidence volume and practitioner interest alone are insufficient.

hypotheses.proposition: Themes transfer between employer sizes, sectors or places.
hypotheses.needed_evidence: Relevant work, remit, horizon and measure; achieved/missing coverage, negative cases and alternative explanations. No subgroup percentages or representative ranking from6–10purposive contributions.

collisions.issue: Repeated sources and programme documents across modules can look like repeated independent support.
collisions.control: Use canonical sources and one programme/case identity, with event/component/date distinctions. Synergy, LFB, ScottishGovernment and WestSussex are not a new employer each time cited.

collisions.issue: Decision, authority, commitment, release, operation and assessed benefit overlap in casual wording.
collisions.control: Retain the exact object, action/date and actual knowledge. Do not compress these fields into one approval/progress stage or an ordinal ladder.

collisions.issue: Approval evidence can be confused with proof of why a decision happened.
collisions.control: Q010 requested evidence,Q011 believed influence, observed decision events and causal effect remain different. Public appraisal guidance is a design principle, not a validated sales recipe.

collisions.issue: Resources, cash, funding, capacity release, efficiency and workforce pay principal can be counted twice or treated as interchangeable.
collisions.control: Keep the three R05 financial views and benefit types, the actual cost unit/lifecycle and usable-time window. A common cost can inform multiple views without being added twice.

collisions.issue: Personal desire, organisation priority, provider roadmap and affected-user value can be conflated.
collisions.control: Record whose claim/outcome, the actual service/task and owner; importance, access, resources and delivery remain separate.

collisions.issue: Historical expectations, present guidance and future policy/service plans invite false trends or completion claims.
collisions.control: Retain original measure/date/status. Old forecast dates do not become later results; conditional policy applicability is checked before final use.

collisions.issue: Constructed recruitment prompts can anchor the final framework on hiring or predetermined routes.
collisions.control: Use prior study only to challenge researcher premises and locate source leads. Preserve unaided case routes and adequate retention/process/learning options; no recommendation count transfer.

collisions.issue: A desired clean chart can hide incompatible populations, missingness or held values.
collisions.control: No synthetic pooled prevalence, market funnel, priority score or cost forecast. Keep held claims excluded, empty original-data arrays intact and unknown/notmeasured/notapplicable/notdisclosed distinct.

report_table_boundary.public_report: Cleared contextual research, actual permissioned practitioner case synthesis, method/limits and framework; practical leader/supplier implications that do not assume a hire.
report_table_boundary.confidential_table: Comparables, buyer/member reservations and commitment, licence/use proposition, JGA costs/revenue/cash/launch choices and recommendation. Public report findings do not prove willingness to pay.
report_table_boundary.restricted_inputs: Identity/consent/linkage and unredacted contributor or buyer material stay in the approved restricted arrangement; no new storage or collection occurs in this task.
